hopper-blue.$description: Hopper Blue — Search button fill, destination links, inline navigation links, and selected product accents — saturated blue punctuates an otherwise achromatic travel interface

white.$description: White — Primary page and card surfaces; white text and outlines over the photographic hero

cloud.$description: Cloud — Muted card and footer-region surfaces

mist.$description: Mist — Secondary page bands and subdued background areas

divider-gray.$description: Divider Gray — 1px card borders, search-field separators, and quiet structural rules

ink.$description: Ink — Headings, search-entry text, and highest-emphasis content

graphite.$description: Graphite — Muted informational text, footer links, and secondary iconography

placeholder-gray.$description: Placeholder Gray — Placeholder text and inactive control icons

proxima-nova.$description: Single-family system for all navigation, controls, destination links, body copy, and headings. The 700-800 heading weights give short labels a compact, punchy travel-retail voice rather than using oversized display type.
